description: Idempotently append a redirect URI to an existing OAuth client's allow-list. The /authorize endpoint exact-matches the redirect_uri parameter against this list; only URIs added via this process (or at registration time) are accepted.
embedding_description: Pre-register a callback URL for an existing OAuth client so claude.ai's authorization_code flow can redirect back to it. Provide client_id and redirect_uri (absolute URL). Returns the full redirect_uris list after the add plus an `added` flag indicating whether this call mutated the list. Idempotent: adding an already-present URI is a no-op that returns added=False.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that the redirect_uri is now registered for the client; surfaces the full updated list and an `added` flag
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Echo the redirect_uris list verbatim so the operator can confirm the URI landed.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Proceed with the OAuth flow that needs this redirect URI registered.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reads the oauth_client row for client_id, appends redirect_uri to its redirect_uris JSON array if not already present, persists via update_state.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: OAuthClientNotFound: client_id is not registered. OAuthClientInvalidName: client_id or redirect_uri is empty/non-string. OAuthClientStoreUnavailable: vault store has not been opened.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For OAuthClientNotFound: register the client first via oauth_client_register. For OAuthClientInvalidName: supply non-empty strings. For OAuthClientStoreUnavailable: wait for vault startup to complete.
